audience: Mathematics researchers and students comparing personal reading/writing with shared paper review
timing_note: These are ordered caption segments, not measured timeline markers. Add start/end times only from the actual recording receipt.
rendering_note: Use one language per caption track; source URLs and local evidence are provenance, not required on-screen text. Show only behavior actually captured in the recording.

segments.text_zh: LaTeX Live 把 TeX 项目放进 Obsidian 笔记空间；Overleaf 让合作者在同一个浏览器项目里写作。
segments.text_en: LaTeX Live brings TeX projects into your Obsidian workspace. Overleaf brings coauthors into one shared browser project.

segments.title_zh: 在源码里读公式与定理
segments.text_zh: 公式与定理就地显示，编辑时恢复源码。Overleaf 也有 Code Editor 和 Visual Editor。
segments.text_en: Read formulas and theorem blocks in place; reveal source as you edit. Overleaf also offers Code and Visual editors.

segments.text_zh: 沿证明中的字面 \ref 查看陈述与证明。图记录源码引用关系，不验证逻辑依赖。
segments.text_en: Follow literal \ref links in proofs to open statements and proofs. The graph records source references, not formally verified dependencies.

segments.title_zh: 同样能在源码与 PDF 间定位
segments.text_zh: 两者都有双向 SyncTeX。LaTeX Live 使用本机 TeX；Overleaf 管理云端编译环境。
segments.text_en: Both support bidirectional SyncTeX. LaTeX Live uses your installed TeX; Overleaf manages cloud builds.

segments.text_zh: Overleaf 已有项目上下文 AI 与写作工具。LaTeX Live 可选接入外部 YOLO 补全，默认关闭。
segments.text_en: Overleaf has project-aware AI and writing tools. LaTeX Live optionally connects to external YOLO completion, disabled by default.

segments.text_zh: 本插件导出单个可重排 HTML，内嵌数学字体与图片。Overleaf 也支持 Pandoc HTML 导出。
segments.text_en: Export one reflowing HTML file with embedded math fonts and images. Overleaf also exports HTML through Pandoc.
segments.boundary: No same-manuscript test of Overleaf HTML packaging or fidelity. Plugin body fonts use system stacks; complex drawings may be SVG; HTML excludes LuaLaTeX.

segments.text_zh: Overleaf 整合评论、修订与历史，部分功能取决于方案。LaTeX Live 的同步与协作需另选工具。
segments.text_en: Overleaf integrates comments, tracked changes and history, with plan-dependent features. LaTeX Live leaves synchronization and collaboration to your chosen tools.

segments.text_zh: 本地数学阅读与证明导航：LaTeX Live。团队论文审阅：Overleaf。尚无同稿速度对照。
segments.text_en: For local mathematical reading and proof navigation: LaTeX Live. For shared paper review: Overleaf. No matched speed benchmark was performed.
